content:
If I hand label data and train on it, is this an external data source? Would I need to open-source this before the competition ends?

I am not sure what the general rules interpretation is here, and there is a massive risk training on data from my interpretation, but I want to know before I try.
no thats not allowed clearly mentioned in rules.

Can you post where you found this? I only see mention specifically prohibiting hand-labeling the competition's validation and test records (section 3.4), not unrelated external data. So I'd still love to see a host answer as that's different than OPs question.
Please point me to where this is stated clearly. I missed it.

Hand labeling data has usually been allowed in previous competition. What you cannot do is label the test data but we don't have access to it. I can't 100% confirm it's allowed for this competition but unless the hosts state otherwise I think you can go ahead.
